overview_description.description: Exonic is a company that focuses on crowdsourcing drug discovery. The platform connects researchers and contributors to work together on identifying and developing new drug candidates. It provides tools and resources that support collaboration in scientific research. The company hosts tournaments or projects where participants can contribute data, ideas, or solutions related to drug development. The company also provides career opportunities for professionals in the science and technology fields.
